answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 19 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a river bet on surviving 52 epochs of grading, and every lagoon settlement recomputes the voyage schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 52 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 21 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
